803:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Briefing Room～

803:t_1:4.en:
$$葵$$
「...The captains must be right in the middle of their strategy meeting by now...」

803:t_1:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「We're finally heading down to $$蒼の地球$$ for the decisive battle with $$新地球皇国$$. I'm itching to get started.」

803:t_1:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「All you ever think about is charging in. Aren't you an even fiercer bull than $$エルーナルーナ$$?」

803:t_1:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't lump me in with that woman!」

803:t_1:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Sorry. $$カレン$$ is a bunny, not a bull, after all.」

803:t_1:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Now, now... $$カレン$$. Whoa there, whoa...」

803:t_1:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「Now you're treating me like a horse?!」

803:t_1:12.en:
$$スザク$$
「If we attack $$ラース・バビロン$$ as we are, we might repeat our last failure.」

803:t_1:14.en:
$$スザク$$
「Right now, almost all of $$蒼の地球$$ is under $$新地球皇国$$'s control...」

803:t_1:15.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Then, to agree with $$カレン$$, shouldn't we break through at a single point?」

803:t_1:16.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$ acknowledged our strength in our recent battle. Naturally, she'll have countermeasures ready.」

803:t_1:17.en:
$$くらら$$
「So if we charge in, we'll just end up getting crushed.」

803:t_1:18.en:
$$葵$$
「What do we do in this situation?」

803:t_1:19.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「A front stretched across the entire Earth is, so to speak, a balloon filled to bursting.」

803:t_1:20.en:
$$スザク$$
「When a front is spread thin and wide, patching one hole opens another...」

803:t_1:21.en:
$$スザク$$
「That causes a chain reaction in other areas and could make their control collapse all at once.」

803:t_1:22.en:
$$葵$$
「I see... So we're the ones who give it that first push.」

803:t_1:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Exactly. ...The $$地球連邦軍$$ has stayed on the defensive this past month to coordinate with our movements.」

803:t_1:24.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「They're planning a major counteroffensive?」

803:t_1:26.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So we'll make holes in the Empire's front to help it succeed.」

803:t_1:27.en:
$$カレン$$
「Now that we know that, all we have to do is act.」

803:t_1:28.en:
$$スザク$$
「Calm down, $$カレン$$. For this strategy to succeed, we need precise information on the Empire's movements.」

803:t_1:29.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「But can we get that information?」

803:t_1:30.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...Don't worry. Apparently, we've just received some perfectly timed assistance.」

803:t_1:32.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The third $$クロノ$$... $$クィーン$$ has contacted us.」

803:t_1:37.en:
$$クィーン$$
「...That is everything I know about the Empire's movements on $$蒼の地球$$.」

803:t_1:38.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You even have information on their allies, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$アマルガム$$, along with every front.」

803:t_1:39.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The third $$クロノ$$, neither Conservatives nor Reformists... Where do you get your information?」

803:t_1:40.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Do you need to ask that?」

803:t_1:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You probably already know, but we seem to have displeased $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ of the Reformists.」

803:t_1:42.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That sounds about right. He's very earnest, but he can be capricious.」

803:t_1:43.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The Conservatives serving the Empire are a concern, but we must watch for a change of heart in our Reformist allies.」

803:t_1:44.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Their military strength is unknown, but with $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ among them, we must be cautious.」

803:t_1:45.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It's pointless to think about it.」

803:t_1:47.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It's like worrying about tomorrow's weather. Whether the sun shines or it rains, you can only accept it.」

803:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you saying we should accept $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

803:t_1:49.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That's for you to decide... All I can give you is information.」

803:t_1:50.en:
$$シャア$$
「Can we trust you to be on our side?」

803:t_1:51.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That hardly sounds like something a man who hid his heart even from his sworn friend should say.」

803:t_1:52.en:
$$シャア$$
「People who speak in such a deliberately abrasive way often turn out to be surprisingly trustworthy.」

803:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You hide your appearance behind an avatar, hide your true feelings, and help us... Perhaps you're a surprisingly charming woman.」

803:t_1:55.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That's a clumsy provocation for you, $$ゼロ$$. A woman won't reveal her true feelings over something like that.」

803:t_1:56.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We have no time to spare for probing each other's motives. We'll make good use of your information.」

803:t_1:58.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You certainly give us useful information, but it is only information. You have never used any tangible power.」

803:t_1:59.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That means you leave the decisions to us. You yourself are neutral, at least for now, I assume.」

803:t_1:60.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Let's leave it at that.」

803:t_1:61.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Then I'll be looking forward to seeing how well you fight.」

803:t_1:62.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If we overthrow the Empire, will you reveal your identity?」

803:t_1:64.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「You still won't let us get a grip on you...」

803:t_1:65.en:
$$オットー$$
「What could she be trying to achieve by directing us...?」

803:t_1:66.en:
$$ブライト$$
「One thing is certain. As the third $$クロノ$$, she follows a different path from both the Empire and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

803:t_1:67.en:
$$シャア$$
「So she'll help us as she did today, as long as that path overlaps with ours.」

803:t_1:68.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even if she dumps the decisions in our laps, her information is useful.」

803:t_1:69.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Her information has also settled our approach for the next phase of $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$.」

803:t_1:70.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Defend Japan, the Empire's final strategic target, contain $$ネオ・ジオン$$ in space, and pursue $$アマルガム$$.」

803:t_1:71.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Correct. We will divide into three forces to handle the situation.」

803:t_1:72.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The Japan Defense Force will use $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ as motherships...」

803:t_1:73.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ザンボット３$$, $$ダイターン３$$, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$, $$クラッシャー隊$$, $$マジンガーチーム$$, the $$ゲッター$$ Team, $$大グレン団$$, $$チームＤ$$...」

803:t_1:74.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We'll send the $$バスターマシン$$s, $$２１世紀警備保障$$, $$ビッグオー$$, the EVA series, both $$アクエリオン$$s, and $$ガンレオン$$ as well.」

803:t_1:76.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$ネオ・ジオン$$ containment force will use $$ラー・カイラム$$, $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and $$プトレマイオス２改$$ as motherships...」

803:t_1:77.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It will consist of our mobile suit force and $$バルゴラ・グローリーＳ$$, which operates in much the same way.」

803:t_1:78.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You could call it an all-Gundam team.」

803:t_1:79.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$アマルガム$$ pursuit force will use $$マクロス・クォーター$$ and $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ as motherships...」

803:t_1:80.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$, Captain $$ガムリン$$, the ASes, KMFs, ATs, $$桂$$, $$レド$$, $$ラケージ$$... and $$リ・ブラスタ$$.」

803:t_1:81.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(This force should be nimble... I could take this chance to look into my suspicions...)

803:t_1:82.en:
$$オットー$$
「It seems $F hasn't been assigned to any of the forces.」

803:t_1:83.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「He's something of a wild card for us.」

803:t_1:84.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The Empire's $$リアクター$$s treat $n a little differently from the other three.」

803:t_1:85.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Could they be encouraging him to mature as a $$リアクター$$, since he's still inexperienced?」
